Application Data.NAME: Trendy Threads Co.
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Fashion Ave, Suite 400, Los Angeles, CA 90015-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Trendy Threads Co. specializes in the retail and wholesale of contemporary clothing and apparel, offering a wide range of styles including casual wear, formal attire, and accessories for men, women, and children. Our operations encompass both in-store sales at our flagship location in Los Angeles and online sales through our e-commerce platform. We source high-quality fabrics and materials from reputable suppliers, ensuring our products meet the latest fashion trends while maintaining durability and comfort. Additionally, we provide personalized customer service, including styling consultations and alterations, to enhance the shopping experience.
